lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere laal jeeu teraa a(n)t na jaanaa ||
lines.translation: O my Dear Beloved Lord, Your limits are not known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) jal thal maheeal bharipur leenaa too(n) aape sarab samaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You pervade the water, the land, and the sky; You Yourself are All-pervading. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਾਰਾਜੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਤੁਲਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man taaraajee chit tulaa teree sev saraaph kamaavaa ||
lines.translation: Mind is the scale, consciousness the weights, and the performance of Your service is the appraiser.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਤੋਲੀ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ghat hee bheetar so sahu tolee in bidh chit rahaavaa ||2||
lines.translation: Deep within my heart, I weigh my Husband Lord; in this way I focus my consciousness. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕੰਡਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਤਰਾਜੀ ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape ka(n)daa tol taraajee aape tolanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are the balance, the weights and the scale; You Yourself are the weigher.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aape dekhai aape boojhai aape hai vanajaaraa ||3||
lines.translation: You Yourself see, and You Yourself understand; You Yourself are the trader. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhulaa neech jaat paradesee khin aavai til jaavai ||
lines.translation: The blind, low class wandering soul, comes for a moment, and departs in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਰਹਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੂੜਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੨॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee sa(n)gat naanak rahadaa kiu kar mooRaa paavai ||4||2||9||
lines.translation: In its company, Nanak dwells; how can the fool attain the Lord? ||4||2||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Soohee, Fourth Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man raam naam aaraadhiaa gur sabad guroo gur ke ||
lines.translation: My mind worships and adores the Lord's Name, through the Guru, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਇਛਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਜਮ ਕੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ichhaa man tan pooreeaa sabh chookaa dar jam ke ||1||
lines.translation: All the desires of my mind and body have been fulfilled; all fear of death has been dispelled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man gun gaavahu raam naam har ke ||
lines.translation: O my mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪੀਆ ਰਸੁ ਗਟਕੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur tuthai man parabodhiaa har peeaa ras gatake ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: And when the Guru is pleased and satisfied, the mind is instructed; it then joyfully drinks in the subtle essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat ootam satigur keree gun gaavai har prabh ke ||
lines.translation: The Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the True Guru, is sublime and exalted. They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਮ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਗ ਜਨ ਕੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har kirapaa dhaar melahu satasa(n)gat ham dhovah pag jan ke ||2||
lines.translation: Bless me with Your Mercy, Lord, and unite me with the Sat Sangat; I wash the feet of Your humble servants. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam sabh hai raam naamaa ras guramat ras rasake ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is all. The Lord's Name is the essence of the Guru's Teachings, the juice, the sweetness of it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਤਿਸ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har a(n)mrit har jal paaiaa sabh laathee tis tis ke ||3||
lines.translation: I have found the Ambrosial Nectar, the Divine Water of the Lord's Name, and all my thirst for it is quenched. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਾਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਮ ਵੇਚਿਓ ਸਿਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamaree jaat paat gur satigur ham vechio sir gur ke ||
lines.translation: The Guru, the True Guru, is my social status and honor; I have sold my head to the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਜਨ ਕੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam pario gur chelaa gur raakhahu laaj jan ke ||4||1||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is called the chaylaa, the disciple of the Guru; O Guru, save the honor of Your servant. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਜਿਓ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਦਾਲਦ ਦਲਘਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam bhajio purakhotam sabh binase daalad dalaghaa ||
lines.translation: I chant and vibrate the Name of the Lord God, the Supreme Being, Har, Har; my poverty and problems have all been eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣਾ ਮੇਟਿਓ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਘਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhau janam maranaa metio gurasabadee har asathir sev sukh samaghaa ||1||
lines.translation: The fear of birth and death has been erased, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; serving the Unmoving, Unchanging Lord, I am absorbed in peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਰਘਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man bhaj raam naam at piraghaa ||
lines.translation: O my mind, vibrate the Name of the most Beloved, Darling Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਵੇਚਿ ਲੀਓ ਮੁਲਿ ਮਹਘਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai man tan arap dhario gur aagai sir vech leeo mul mahaghaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have dedicated my mind and body, and placed them in offering before the Guru; I have sold my head to the Guru, for a very dear price. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਕੜਿ ਖੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਲਘਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: narapat raaje ra(n)g ras maanahi bin naavai pakaR khaRe sabh kalaghaa ||
lines.translation: The kings and the rulers of men enjoy pleasures and delights, but without the Name of the Lord, death seizes and dispatches them all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡੁ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੇ ਹਥ ਫਲਘਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dharam raai sir da(n)d lagaanaa phir pachhutaane hath phalaghaa ||2||
lines.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma strikes them over the heads with his staff, and when the fruits of their actions come into their hands, then they regret and repent. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਜਨ ਕਿਰਮ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਲਘਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har raakh raakh jan kiram tumaare saranaagat purakh pratipalaghaa ||
lines.translation: Save me, save me, Lord; I am Your humble servant, a mere worm. I seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary, O Primal Lord, Cherisher and Nourisher.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲੋਚ ਪੂਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਘਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: darasan sa(n)t dehu sukh paavai prabh loch poor jan tumaghaa ||3||
lines.translation: Please bless me with the Blessed Vision of the Saint's Darshan, that I may find peace. O God, please fulfill the desires of Your humble servant. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਘਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum samarath purakh vade prabh suaamee mo kau keejai daan har nimaghaa ||
lines.translation: You are the All-powerful, Great, Primal God, my Lord and Master. O Lord, please bless me with the gift of humility.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਮ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਘੁਮਘਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam milai sukh paavai ham naam vitahu sad ghumaghaa ||4||2||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has found the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and is at peace; I am forever a sacrifice to the Naam. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਙੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਙੁ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਙੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naamaa har ra(n)ng hai har ra(n)ng majeethai ra(n)ng ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is the Love of the Lord. The Lord's Love is the permanent color.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਾੜਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭੰਙੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur tuthai har ra(n)g chaaRiaa phir bahuR na hovee bha(n)ng ||1||
lines.translation: When the Guru is totally satisfied and pleased, He colors us with the Lord's Love; this color shall never fade away. ||1||
